RECOMMENDATIONS
4 exploitable tendencies — these situations are both predictable and underperforming. A prepared DC will take away your lean.
3rd & Long: you pass 100% (n=8) at 7.3 yds/38% success — the lean isn't paying off, and a DC keys pass — drops into coverage and sits on the sticks. Add a draw, QB run, or screen off the same formation.
4th & Long: you run 100% (n=8) at 5.8 yds/25% success — the lean isn't paying off, and a DC keys run — loads the box and cheats a safety down. Add play-action, a quick throw, or a screen off the same look.
